tools.name: OpenRouter
tools.description: LLM routing layer for all content generation — blog drafts, captions, SEO copy, email newsletters, and video scripts.

tools.name: Notion
tools.description: Draft storage and collaboration workspace. All generated content is saved as Notion pages for review before publishing.

create_page.description: Create a new draft page with blog post, captions, or newsletter content.

update_page.description: Update an existing draft with revisions or additional content.

query_database.description: Query the EEVL content drafts database to check for existing drafts.

append_blocks.description: Append content blocks (text, headings, images) to an existing page.

tools.name: Google Drive
tools.description: Asset reference storage. Used to retrieve brand assets, templates, and reference materials during content creation.

list_files.description: List files in the EEVL brand assets folder.

get_file.description: Retrieve a specific asset file (brand guide PDF, template doc, image).

export_file.description: Export Google Docs/Sheets to a usable format (Markdown, CSV).
